title: Draganfly's Record Q2 Performance Signals High-Flying Future for Drone Tech
summary: Draganfly Inc., a leader in drone solutions, has announced stellar second-quarter results for 2026, showcasing robust underlying gross profit percentages. This strong financial showing underscores the growing demand for advanced drone technology across various sectors and solidifies Draganfly's market position.
content:
Vancouver-based Draganfly Inc. (NASDAQ: DPRO), a name synonymous with cutting-edge drone technology, just delivered a remarkable second-quarter financial report for 2026. The award-winning drone solutions developer announced record results, providing a significant uplift to its market position and hinting at robust growth within the burgeoning drone industry.

Digging into the financials, the company revealed an impressive underlying gross profit. When factoring out non-cash inventory write-downs of $43,662 and $10,421 for the three-month period ending June 30, Draganfly’s gross profit as a percentage of revenues stood strong at 21.7% and 24.3% respectively. These figures are not just encouraging; they underscore a lean operational efficiency and solid demand for their specialized drone systems, showcasing the true economic health of the company's core business.

This banner performance for Draganfly isn't just a corporate win; it's a bellwether for the broader unmanned aerial systems market. As industries from agriculture and logistics to public safety and infrastructure inspection increasingly adopt drone technology, companies like Draganfly, known for their industry-leading innovations, are perfectly positioned to capitalize. Their suite of solutions, spanning hardware, software, and services, continues to address complex challenges, driving both revenue and market trust.

The sustained profitability, even when accounting for the nuances of inventory management, paints a clear picture: Draganfly is not just flying high on current trends but building a sustainable runway for future expansion. This record quarter solidifies its role as a key player in the evolution of drone technology, promising continued innovation and market leadership in a sector ripe with opportunity.
keyTakeaways: Draganfly Inc. reported record-setting financial results for its second quarter ending June 30, 2026.
The company's underlying gross profit as a percentage of revenues reached 21.7% and 24.3% when excluding non-cash inventory write-downs.
Draganfly's strong performance highlights robust demand for advanced drone solutions and solidifies its position as a market leader in the rapidly expanding drone industry.
author: GlobeNewswire

title: Meta Unleashes 'Muse Glimmer,' Bringing Powerful AI Directly to Your Desktop — With a Zuckerberg Warning
summary: Meta has unveiled Muse Glimmer, an open-source language model with 30 billion parameters capable of running on personal computers, marking a significant step toward democratizing advanced AI. This release coincides with a thoughtful essay from CEO Mark Zuckerberg, addressing the critical risks and responsible development necessary for the future of artificial intelligence.
content:
Meta is once again shaking up the AI landscape, this time by bringing truly powerful artificial intelligence directly to your personal computer. The company today launched Muse Glimmer, an open-source language model boasting a formidable 30 billion parameters, designed with the audacious goal of running locally on consumer hardware.

This isn't just another cloud-based behemoth; Muse Glimmer's ability to operate offline signifies a crucial shift toward democratizing AI access. For developers and enthusiasts, it means unprecedented control, enhanced privacy, and the freedom to innovate without constant reliance on remote servers. It’s a bold move that not only fosters a more robust open-source ecosystem but also directly challenges the centralized control often seen with proprietary models.

Accompanying this significant technical release is a lengthy, introspective essay from Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg himself. In it, Zuckerberg delves deep into the multifaceted risks associated with artificial intelligence, echoing concerns that have become increasingly prominent across the tech world. His candid discussion underscores Meta’s commitment, at least philosophically, to navigating these challenges responsibly, suggesting that open collaboration and transparent development — tenets embodied by Muse Glimmer — are key to building a safer, more beneficial AI future.

Meta's continued push into open-source AI, exemplified by projects like Llama and now Muse Glimmer, positions them as a leading voice in a burgeoning community dedicated to shared innovation. This strategy could empower a new generation of AI applications, moving advanced capabilities out of the data center and into the hands of millions.
keyTakeaways: Meta launched Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion parameter open-source language model designed to run directly on personal computers.
The release is paired with an essay by CEO Mark Zuckerberg, which openly discusses the inherent risks and the importance of responsible AI development.
Muse Glimmer signifies a major step towards democratizing AI, offering enhanced privacy and fostering innovation by enabling local, offline operation.
author: Maria Deutscher
